{{Top|leg}}
A '''poison kit''' was small portable equipment kit that could be used to concoct various [[Poison/Legends|poisons]]. [[Tiber Quent]] carried a poison kit that was a modified [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]]. The kit included vials of poison, mixing jars, a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]], [[airhypo]]s, and stirrers.
